Dr. Carrie

A human perspective.
An analytical understanding.

My work brings together human development, neurodiversity, and relationships. I’m interested in the patterns we live with—and the possibilities we may not yet see.

The thinking behind the work

A broader perspective

Curiosity, experience,
and a beginner’s mind.

As a counselor educator, consultant, and coach based in San Francisco, I bring clinical understanding and a humanistic perspective to working with individuals and couples.

My background spans cognitive diversity, human development, mindfulness, expressive arts, and systems thinking. I examine how behavior and relationships take shape within the wider context of a person’s life.
